text:
arya: Heads up — albatross18b (int4) canary warmstart is hitting OOMs on a few nodes in the canary pool. Seen during high-concurrency warm traffic.

sam: ugh, saw spikes earlier. memory fragmentation jumps during kv cache build. logs attached.

lucas: Can you paste a short log snippet?

arya: sure — minimal: 
```
[2026-03-20T14:12:03Z] node=gpu-14 alloc failed: requested 2147483648 bytes, free largest chunk 17825792
[2026-03-20T14:12:03Z] kv-cache: created 3 segments, slot fragmentation 0.37
[2026-03-20T14:12:04Z] prefetched 6 prefixes, inflight=24, batch_size=16
```

eva: that free-largest-chunk number screams fragmentation, not total usage. two quick wins: lower default max_new_tokens for albatross to 32; enable slot-compactor with gentle cadence.

sam: agreed. also try disabling aggressive prefetching for warmstart on canary: it inflates transient allocations.

arya: proposed canary patch: 
```
model_defaults:
  albatross18b:
    max_new_tokens: 32
    prefetch: false
    batching:
      max_batch_tokens: 4096
      max_concurrent: 6
    slot_compactor:
      enabled: true
      cadence_s: 30
      target_frag: 0.15
```

lucas: i like the slow-start idea too — start with concurrency=1 then ramp over 5m. reduces simultaneous kv builds.

eva: yep — add warmup_policy: 
```
warmup_policy:
  initial_concurrency: 1
  ramp_minutes: 5
  step_up: 2
```

sam: i'm going to push a canary with those changes to pool-canary-2. keeping batch size conservative.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy 3587654321-albatross-warmstart-patch -> pool-canary-2 started by sam at 2026-03-20T14:20:11Z :rocket:

arya: monitoring memory fragmentation and tail-latency. will post results in ~10m.

lucas: if still flaky, next step is a soft kv-evict that trims tails after each request during warm period. low risk.

eva: +1 — also add a regression eval run against our QA prompt set to ensure quant int4 quality hasn't regressed with the new batching cadence.

arya: quick status: after patch, stretched nodes show fragmentation down to ~0.16 and no further OOMs in last 12m. tail latency stable. QA eval queued. :thumbsup:

sam: nice. i'll roll to the rest of the canary pools with same safe defaults. thanks team.

arya: filing a short runbook note for albatross warmstart heuristics after QA passes.

lucas: add a note about potential fallback to float16 model variant if persistent production spikes occur.

arya: noted. will include fallback trigger: >3 OOMs in 30m -> fallback to albatross18b-fp16 variant and alert on-call.

sam: cool. closing the loop here — follow-up thread for QA results if anything pops.
